terra.problem: It gives a reason the LORD keeps speaking, but the text does not state one.
Papa describes having a snooze button. Things outside his bakery, such as an alarm, should come up as things people use, not as his possessions.

The claim that the Bible has plenty of fields is a Bible fact from outside the passage and has no reference.
It says trusting is all the verse tells the person to do, though the verse also says to lean on his God.
The text addresses those who kindle fires and tells them to walk in their light; it does not say they are already walking in it.
